($930.42 per diem), and the accrued unpaid interest in the amount of $155,070, plus OPEH’s
reasonable costs of collection including, without limitation, reasonable attorneys’ fees, and the

costs of this action, in accordance with the terms of the Promissory Note.

CONCLUSION

For all of the foregoing reasons, OPEH’s motion for summary judgment in lieu of
complaint should be granted and judgment should be entered in favor of Plaintiff OPEH LLC
and against Defendants Michael E. Bleich and Alexis K. Bleich $2,233,007, together with
interest from September 17, 2018 until paid at the agreed upon rate of 15% per annum ($930.42
per diem), until paid, and the accrued unpaid interest in the amount of $155,070, but in no event
less than the amount of $2,388,077, plus OPEH’s reasonable costs of collection including,
without limitation, reasonable attorneys’ fees, and the costs of this action, in accordance with the
terms of the Promissory Note, and such other and further relief that this Court deems just and

proper.

Dated: September 27, 2018

TARTER KRINSKY & DROGIN LLP
